title: Convert a baby scale into a toddler floor scale: hold the release button, slide the cradle tray back, set on the mat
instruction: Hold the baby scale's front release button in while sliding the curved weighing tray back off the scale base without moving the base off its marks, set the tray upright on the grey mat, then let go and move both hands clear.
context: In paediatric, family, WIC and home-visit clinics, medical assistants (O*NET 31-9092.00: "Interview patients to obtain medical information and measure their vital signs, weight, and height."; 833,900 US workers), registered nurses (29-1141.00: "Record patients' medical information and vital signs."; 3,465,400) and LPNs (29-2061.00: "Measure and record patients' vital signs, such as height, weight..."; 666,900) convert the seca 354 between infants and standing children (manual Fig. 5: "When weighing children able to stand up: Remove the tray as described."). Its 525 x 80 x 250 mm open scoop locks onto the 280 x 65 x 235 mm base (Fig. 1-2: "press the release button hard and slide back the tray (Fig. 2)"). Harder than a one-hand release from a bolted bracket: the unbolted 1.47 kg base lifts off its marks if the tray is pulled up before its 20 mm slide, the tray leaves in two axes (back, then up out of its keyholes), and the 525 mm scoop takes both hands to carry.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left, z up from the bench); fixed layout, nothing varies with seed. Centred on y = 0 in front sits an assembled seca 354 Digital Baby & Floor Scale (2.30 kg net, 55.2 x 15.6 x 33.2 cm assembled): the 28.0 x 6.5 x 23.5 cm white toddler platform (1.47 kg, closed standing deck) rests free on four rubber corner feet inside yellow corner tape marks at (25.05, 0.0) (x = 13.3..36.8, y = -14.0..+14.0); its 8.2 cm front apron shows the LCD, the red seca badge, four round keys and the light-grey round release button (30 g) centred at (17.2, 0.0, +7.05), with the recessed latch step right behind it. Locked onto the platform sits the 52.5 x 8.0 x 25.0 cm open-ended infant weighing tray (0.80 kg) at (34.0, 0.0) (x = 21.5..46.5, y = -26.25..+26.25, top at +15.6). Behind the scale at (63.0, 0.0) (x = 48.5..77.5, y = -18.5..+18.5, 2.0 cm clear behind the tray) lies a grey IKEA TILLGANG polypropylene tray (the mat), Art. 104.199.50 (29.0 x 37.0 x 2.0 cm, 0.30 kg).
scoring: Whole-trial rules (checked from the trial video; the final photo confirms the end state): 0 for good if at any step the scale base is lifted more than 8.0 mm at a corner or shifted more than 15.0 mm from its taped corner marks, or if the weighing tray falls onto the bench or flips upside-down, or any body falls off the bench (in simulation: downward bench impact > 0.50 m/s, z < -2.0 cm, or tilt > 90 deg). Benign touches score nothing off. Otherwise scored at the end of the trial: 1.0 if the detached weighing tray rests upright (tilt <= 8.0 deg) on the flat grey mat (mat tilt <= 5.0 deg; tray centre within 3.0 cm front-to-back and 5.0 cm sideways of the mat's centre, by ruler against the mat's 29.0 x 37.0 cm outer edges), the release button is back within 1.0 mm of its top rest, the scale base sits within 15.0 mm and 3.0 deg of its marks, both hands are at least 3.0 cm clear of scale, button, tray and mat, and all bodies stay at rest (< 2.0 cm/s, < 0.20 rad/s, <= 2.0 mm drift) for 1.0 s; 0.5 when 1.0 is not met while the tray is unlocked and separated from the scale base (slid >= 2.0 cm back, or moved clear of the base) with the base undisturbed; 0.0 otherwise.
reset_notes: Under 30 seconds between trials (no consumables): set the grey mat flat at (63.0, 0.0) cm; set the seca 354 base inside its four yellow corner tape marks at (25.05, 0.0) cm with the LCD facing the arms (-x); position the tray on the base and pull it forward (-x) until it snaps into place and the release button is in its top position (seca manual Fig. 1); check the lock with a gentle 2 mm upward pull and compare with setup.png.
fidelity: PhysX rigid bodies at 1:1 maker outer sizes. The open scoop: a 6 mm floor with a 16 mm rolled edge along each open end, walls stepping down toward the ends. The latch is simplified: two T-studs in keyhole slots of the recessed front step hold the tray until it slides 20 mm back; the button's pawl (12 N at 5 mm, estimate) blocks the slide unless pressed 4.3 mm; no welds or pose snaps. Two underside ribs stand in for the real tray bridging the mat's 20 mm side rims. Electronics unmodelled.
